ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Actuarial Science, Gies College of Business Majors and Curriculum Unassigned. On Monday, November 12, registration will be opened to Agri-Accounting, Finance in Agribusiness, Agri-Finance, Consumer Economics and Finance majors, and Technology and Management minors. On Monday, November 19, registration will be opened to Business Minors. All restrictions will lift on January 7th, and any remaining seats will be made available to any campus major.
